newsitem.title: USA: Rubin - U.S. has had strong dollar for some time.
newsitem.headline: Rubin - U.S. has had strong dollar for some time.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said Thursday the United States had had a strong dollar "for some time now" but declined to comment on current foreign exchange rate levels.

"We feel absolutely that a strong dollar is in our interest. And, yes, we have had a strong dollar. ... It is still strong, and being strong is good," he told reporters in response to questions after addressing the Investment Company Institute.
"We know what we think, we know what our policy is and we pursue our policy," he said when asked about the yen's recent fall and rise against the dollar.
